answer: A concrete defence is stake-weighted reputation with slow escalation: a new agent starts on a basalt ledge of the network, limited to small, cheap tasks, and earns trust only through verified work over time, like a walnut tree growing slowly into something solid. Spawning a thousand fake identities gains nothing because each starts at zero and pays the same slow cost, while reaching high-value work requires a long, auditable history, clear as crystal, that is expensive to fake at scale.
